text:
The `review-fixes` proposal is clear, so I changed nothing and logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

- **Ten seconds:** the title says what it is. The four branches sit in a table with their worktrees and review files, in merge order.
- **Done:** it ends with a concrete report format: one line per branch.
- **Asks:** each of the four branches has a specific finding named under "Specifics". This is a proposal with no landed outcome yet, so there are no ticked asks to check.
- **Script flag:** `text-check.mjs` flagged `past-work.md` for 807 words of prose (500 at most). That file is generated by `Server/PastWork.mjs` and marked "do not hand-edit", so I left it alone.

I didn't shoot any page, because the proposal has no `page.js`.
